description: This file defines a SwiftUI View named RootTabs which manages a tabbed interface with 'Screen', 'Voice', and 'Settings' tabs, various overlays such as status indicators, toast messages for voice commands, and a dialog for gateway actions. It interacts with environment objects and manages UI state related to voice wake features and gateway status.

classes.name: RootTabs
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that presents a tab bar interface with additional overlays and state management for gateway status and voice command feedback.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the UI layout for the tab view, overlays, and interactions, including handling voice wake toast display and gateway actions dialog.

methods.name: gatewayStatus
methods.description: Computes and returns the current gateway connection status indicator for display in the UI.

methods.name: statusActivity
methods.description: Builds and returns the current activity status related to the app model, voice wake, and camera HUD to be shown in the UI.
